description: Owner road drives with the acc and acc_summaries profiles. acc: sunnypilot with the ported upstream acc patch, Experimental mode; the first two drives (1.4 h) in detail, then seven further drives. acc_summaries: the first two drives on StarPilot. Exploratory: small n, no tuning on these drives; replay remains the main evidence. Comparison: the owner's fused 2.1.0 road drives (road_v21.json).
acc_points: 1 point whenever 0x239 reports a target; matches the decoded ACC range on 98 % of ticks
stop_distance_note: with a lead speed near zero the planner holds openpilot's designed stop distance (STOP_DISTANCE 6 m); fused's small positive low-speed lead speed let the MPC creep closer

acc_all_drives.note: moving and engaged hours summed over the three batches (1.23 + 0.66 + 0.85 moving h; 0.95 + 0.13 + 0.54 engaged h); every engaged hard request in the later seven drives (9) followed a real slowing lead that was radar-backed

acc_summaries_first_drives.events: one stop-and-go cycle, one stopped-queue approach with a launch, one hard lead stop, two following stretches
